Tracing the path:
- From (0,3) going up-right at 45°: it reaches the top cushion at (3,6).
- Reflecting down-right at 45°: from (3,6) it moves along (3+s, 6−s). At s = 6 it arrives at (9,0) — exactly the bottom-right corner.

Checking: it hits x = 9 and y = 0 simultaneously, so it drops into the corner pocket at (9,0), which is pocket A.

\boxed{A}
